Experience Personal Wellness at Home with the Dynamic Cardoba 2-Person Infrared Sauna

Bring a two-person infrared cabin into your home with the Dynamic Cardoba 2-Person Low EMF FAR Infrared Sauna. Crafted from natural Canadian hemlock and designed for comfort and style, this compact indoor sauna delivers deep therapeutic heat using 7 Carbon PureTech™ Low EMF heating panels, making it ideal for health-conscious individuals seeking safe, consistent warmth.

With a footprint of just 46″ x 41″, this cabin-style sauna comfortably seats two while fitting easily in most indoor spaces, including home gyms, master bedrooms, or wellness corners. The clasp-together assembly system and 120V/15amp plug mean there’s no need for special electrical work—just assemble and relax.

Enjoy full control of your session with the interior LED panel, integrated Bluetooth and MP3 audio system, and dynamic stereo speakers, so you can unwind to your favorite playlists or guided meditations. Enhanced with chromotherapy lighting (red light therapy feature starting in 2024 models), this sauna also promotes mood balance and relaxation, making it more than just heat therapy—it’s a whole-body experience.

The tempered glass door and roof vent ensure airflow and visibility, while the hypoallergenic hemlock wood construction adds beauty, durability, and a subtle natural aroma.

The Dynamic Cardoba runs on a standard 120V outlet and uses 7 Carbon PureTech™ Low EMF panels.

Key Benefits

  • Safe, ultra-low EMF FAR infrared heating
  • Easy plug-and-play setup with standard 120V outlet
  • Compact cabin design fits most indoor spaces
  • Built-in Bluetooth speakers and chromotherapy lighting for full sensory relaxation

Transform your space into a wellness retreat.

Canadian hemlock, two seats, and a standard outlet — engineered for comfort, designed for your lifestyle.
